quickstart.ts — Verdis RPC Connection (Chain ID 909) 
// Quickstart: Connect & Query Verdis Mainnet RPC (Chain ID 909)
const RPC_URL = 'https://rpc.verdischain.com';

async function queryVerdisNode() {
  const response = await fetch(RPC_URL, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      jsonrpc: '2.0',
      id: 1,
      method: 'eth_chainId',
      params: []
    })
  });

  const data = await response.json();
  const chainId = parseInt(data.result, 16);
  console.log(`Connected to Verdis Chain ID: ${chainId}`); // Outputs: 909

  // Fetch real-time Proof-of-Green block metrics
  const ecoRes = await fetch(RPC_URL, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 2, method: 'verdis_getLatestEcoBlock', params: [] })
  });
  const ecoBlock = await ecoRes.json();
  console.log('Current Carbon Offset:', ecoBlock.result.carbonOffsetKg, 'kg CO2');
}

queryVerdisNode();

Token Transfer

Execute native VRS or ERC-20 green token transfers with Viem & Chain ID 909.

Core Viem v2 
import { createWalletClient, http, parseEther } from 'viem';
import { verdisMainnet } from '@verdis/sdk';

// Initialize Verdis Viem Client for Chain ID 909
const client = createWalletClient({
  chain: verdisMainnet, // chainId: 909
  transport: http('https://rpc.verdischain.com')
});

async function sendVRSTransfer() {
  const hash = await client.sendTransaction({
    account: '0x742d35Cc6634C0532925a3b844Bc454e4438f44e',
    to: '0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890',
    value: parseEther('100.5') // Transfer 100.5 VRS
  });

  console.log(`Transaction Confirmed! Hash: ${hash}`);
}

DEX Swap

Perform automated market maker swaps on VerdisSwap with slippage protection.

DeFi Ethers.js 
import { ethers } from 'ethers';
import { VERDIS_ROUTER_ABI } from '@verdis/sdk/abis';

const provider = new ethers.JsonRpcProvider('https://rpc.verdischain.com');
const wallet = new ethers.Wallet(process.env.PRIVATE_KEY, provider);
const router = new ethers.Contract('0x9090000000000000000000000000000000000001', VERDIS_ROUTER_ABI, wallet);

async function swapVRSForECO(amountVRS: string) {
  const path = ['0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000909', '0xECO0000000000000000000000000000000000909'];
  const deadline = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 1200;

  const tx = await router.swapExactETHForTokens(
    0, path, wallet.address, deadline,
    { value: ethers.parseEther(amountVRS) }
  );
  await tx.wait();
  console.log(`DEX Swap Complete: ${tx.hash}`);
}
🌊 Slippage: 0.1% ⚡ High Yield Pool

Deploy Smart Contract

Programmatically deploy EVM contracts to Verdis with carbon attestation logs.

EVM ContractFactory 
import { ethers } from 'ethers';

const ABI = ["constructor(string name, string symbol)", "function mint(address to, uint256 amount)"];
const BYTECODE = '0x608060405234801561001057600080fd5b50604051...';

async function deployGreenToken() {
  const provider = new ethers.JsonRpcProvider('https://rpc.verdischain.com');
  const wallet = new ethers.Wallet(process.env.PRIVATE_KEY, provider);

  const factory = new ethers.ContractFactory(ABI, BYTECODE, wallet);
  console.log('Deploying to Verdis Chain ID 909...');

  const contract = await factory.deploy('Green Carbon Credit', 'GCC');
  await contract.waitForDeployment();
  console.log(`Contract Deployed: ${await contract.getAddress()}`);
}
🛠️ EVM Compatible 📜 Solc 0.8.24

Add Liquidity

Supply VRS and ERC-20 liquidity to earn automated swap fee rewards.

DeFi LP Provider 
import { ethers } from 'ethers';
import { VERDIS_ROUTER_ABI, ERC20_ABI } from '@verdis/sdk';

async function addPoolLiquidity(vrsAmount: string, tokenAddr: string, tokenAmount: string) {
  const provider = new ethers.JsonRpcProvider('https://rpc.verdischain.com');
  const wallet = new ethers.Wallet(process.env.PRIVATE_KEY, provider);
  const router = new ethers.Contract('0x9090000000000000000000000000000000000001', VERDIS_ROUTER_ABI, wallet);
  const token = new ethers.Contract(tokenAddr, ERC20_ABI, wallet);

  await (await token.approve(router.target, ethers.parseEther(tokenAmount))).wait();

  const tx = await router.addLiquidityETH(
    tokenAddr, ethers.parseEther(tokenAmount), 0, 0,
    wallet.address, Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 600,
    { value: ethers.parseEther(vrsAmount) }
  );
  console.log(`Liquidity Position Created: ${tx.hash}`);
}
📊 APY: ~18.4% 🛡️ Auto-Compound

Mint Carbon Credit

Issue dMRV-verified carbon credit certificates with IoT sensor attestation.

ESG Protocol dMRV Verified 
import { VerdisGreenRegistry } from '@verdis/sdk/carbon';

const registry = new VerdisGreenRegistry({
  rpcUrl: 'https://rpc.verdischain.com', // Chain ID 909
  privateKey: process.env.ORACLE_KEY
});

async function mintCarbonCertificate() {
  const receipt = await registry.mintCarbonCreditNFT({
    recipient: '0x8888888888888888888888888888888888888888',
    tonsCO2: 1500, // 1,500 Tonnes Metric CO2 Offset
    mrvSensorId: 'SOLAR-AZ-2026-909',
    metadataUri: 'ipfs://bafybeig.../solar-audit.json'
  });

  console.log(`Carbon Credit Minted! TokenID: ${receipt.tokenId}`);
}

Stake VRS

Stake native VRS into Proof-of-Green-Stake validators for sustainable yield.

Staking PoGS Consensus 
import { ethers } from 'ethers';
import { VERDIS_STAKING_ABI } from '@verdis/sdk/staking';

const STAKING_CONTRACT = '0x9090000000000000000000000000000000000002';

async function stakeVRSTokens(amountInVRS: number, lockDays: number) {
  const provider = new ethers.JsonRpcProvider('https://rpc.verdischain.com');
  const wallet = new ethers.Wallet(process.env.PRIVATE_KEY, provider);
  const staking = new ethers.Contract(STAKING_CONTRACT, VERDIS_STAKING_ABI, wallet);

  const tx = await staking.stake(lockDays, {
    value: ethers.parseEther(amountInVRS.toString())
  });

  await tx.wait();
  console.log(`Staked ${amountInVRS} VRS! Earn rate: 14.2% APR`);
}

Mint NFT

Mint ERC-721 Eco-NFTs with IPFS metadata & carbon-neutral certification badge.

NFT ERC-721 
import { ethers } from 'ethers';
import { ECO_NFT_ABI } from '@verdis/sdk/nft';

const NFT_CONTRACT = '0x9090000000000000000000000000000000000004';

async function mintEcoNFT(recipient: string, ipfsMetadataUri: string) {
  const provider = new ethers.JsonRpcProvider('https://rpc.verdischain.com');
  const wallet = new ethers.Wallet(process.env.PRIVATE_KEY, provider);
  const nft = new ethers.Contract(NFT_CONTRACT, ECO_NFT_ABI, wallet);

  const tx = await nft.mintEcoNFT(recipient, ipfsMetadataUri);
  const receipt = await tx.wait();
  console.log(`NFT Minted on Chain ID 909! Hash: ${receipt.hash}`);
}
